title: incus-spawn config.yaml
description: isx's host configuration, ~/.config/incus-spawn/config.yaml: credential accounts and global settings. isx init writes the credentials, so edit by hand only what the settings below describe. A tool may add a namespace of its own, so another top-level key is not an error.

claude.description: Claude credentials. Accounts by name, and which one is the default.

accounts.description: Claude accounts by name. Each has a type, and the fields of that type.

type.description: api-key is an Anthropic API key, oauth is a Claude Pro or Max token, vertex is Google Cloud Vertex AI.

apiKey.description: The Anthropic API key, for type api-key.

oauthToken.description: The token claude setup-token minted, for type oauth.

cloudMlRegion.description: The Vertex AI region, for type vertex.

vertexProjectId.description: The Google Cloud project, for type vertex.

default.description: The account an instance uses unless its template or its own choice names another.

github.description: GitHub credentials: accounts with a token and an email, and which is the default.

openai.description: OpenAI credentials: accounts with an apiKey, and which is the default.

bob.description: Bob credentials: accounts with an apiKey and licenseConsent, and which is the default.

features.description: Feature flags to turn on. A tool that names a feature in its feature: key builds only when it is listed.

searchPaths.description: Directories to load templates and tools from, each with images/ and tools/ subdirectories. A tilde expands.

host-path.description: Retired: one host directory of checkouts. Read, and written as host-paths.

host-paths.description: Host directories isx looks in for checkouts, with which it manages git remotes.

repo-paths.description: A host checkout for each repository, by name.

incus-bridge-gateway.description: The address of Incus's bridge, when isx cannot find it itself.

preferred-agent.description: The coding agent you prefer, by its tool's name, such as claude. It limits nothing: a template installs the agent its tools list names.

tui-live-refresh.description: Whether the TUI updates live as instances change elsewhere. false falls back to polling.

artifact-cache.description: How long the proxy trusts a cached Maven or Gradle artifact's last confirmation with upstream.

fresh.description: How long a confirmation is trusted before the artifact is confirmed again, such as 30m or 2h.

max-stale.description: How long past that the proxy serves a copy it cannot confirm, such as 7d.

git-cache.description: Limits of the cache of clean Git snapshots a build reads. 0 turns persistent retention off.

snapshot-max-mib.description: The largest snapshot kept, in MiB.

max-age-days.description: How long an unused snapshot is kept, in days.

git-transfer.description: When a Git transfer on the host is ended. 0 turns a bound off.

stall.description: Ended after this long with no output, no I/O and next to no CPU. Default 5m.

timeout.description: Ended after this long in any case. Default 3h.

ready-timeouts.description: How long a start waits for something to answer before it fails.

proxy.description: The proxy after isx proxy install or start. Default 30s.

host-routes.description: Names instances reach that the proxy forwards to a controller on this host. A name ends in .internal.

target.description: Where the controller listens, on this host's loopback: localhost, a 127.x.x.x address or [::1], with a port.

templates.description: Required: only instances of these templates may call the route.

exposed-host-ports.description: Loopback ports of this host that every instance with network reaches at host.isx.internal:<port>.

maven-repositories.description: Maven repositories beyond the built-in ones whose artifacts the proxy caches.

url.description: The repository, up to where the Maven coordinates begin.

access.description: public, or private with the credentials namespace whose account isx injects there.

credentials.description: The credential namespace isx injects, for a private repository.

confirm.description: How a cached copy is checked against upstream: checksum-header when the server sends X-Checksum-SHA1, etag-sha1 when its ETag is the artifact's SHA-1 (a Nexus 3 hosted repository), sidecar when each artifact is published with its .sha1 and never replaced.

replaces-releases.description: true when a release can be uploaded again with other content. The repository is then confirmed before every serve.

fresh.description: As in artifact-cache, for this repository alone. 0 by default.

max-stale.description: As in artifact-cache, for this repository alone. 0 by default.

maven-mirrors.description: Mirrors the proxy asks first for an artifact its cache does not hold.

repository.description: A repository the proxy caches: one of Maven Central's two names, the Gradle plugin portal, or a public one declared above.

drivers.description: What an external tool that drives isx may do to the instances it owns, by the tool's name.

destroy.description: Lets isx destroy --owner <name> delete the instances that tool owns.

git-identity.description: The name and email agents commit under when no GitHub account gives them one. isx init writes it only after you say yes.

name.description: The user.name of the agents' commits.

email.description: The user.email of the agents' commits.

host-ca.description: Whether the host's CA certificates are installed in instances. true or false alone is the same as propagate: with that value.

propagate.description: Install the certificates of the host's /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/ beside the isx CA in every instance.

duration.description: A duration such as 30s, 5m, 2h or 7d. 0 is none.

default.description: The account an instance uses unless its template or its own choice names another.
